item.title: Ohio State’s NCAA Tournament Hopes Take Major Blow in 74-57 Blowout Loss at Iowa
item.description: A pivotal game for Ohio State’s NCAA Tournament chances turned into a disasterclass at Iowa on Wednesday. item.title: NFL Scouting Combine A Childhood Dream Come True for Former Ohio State Defensive End Caden Curry
item.description: As a child growing up in Greenwood, Indiana, Caden Curry frequently attended the NFL Scouting Combine as a fan. Now, the former Ohio State defensive end is participating in the NFL Scouting Combine himself. “It's a dream come true,” Curry said. “I mean, ever since I was a kid, being able to come over here and watch all the great athletes before me, and just to be living it, be behind the scenes and just be able to compete.” Curry is no stranger to competing inside Lucas Oil Stadium. item.description: Caleb Downs didn't hesitate much when asked whether he was the best defender in this year's NFL draft. item.title: Sonny Styles Wows at NFL Scouting Combine with 43.5-Inch Vertical Jump, 11-Foot-2 Broad Jump and 4.46-Second 40-Yard Dash
item.description: Sonny Styles is leaping his way up draft boards at the NFL Scouting Combine. The former Ohio State linebacker posted historically great numbers with a 43.5-inch vertical jump and an 11-foot-2 broad jump, showing why he’s one of the top prospects in the 2026 NFL draft class. Styles’ vertical jump was the second-best ever for a linebacker at the NFL Scouting Combine behind only Cameron Wake, who had a 45.5-inch vertical jump in 2005. item.description: Arvell Reese and Sonny Styles solidified their stock as the NFL draft’s top two linebackers at the 2026 NFL Scouting Combine.
